content.text: 2022 First launched 5079 Passengers 33 Ports visited $118 From Price per day 153,516 Gross Tonnage Overview Cruise Calendar Onboard Experience Destinations Cabins Deck Plans Ship Location 4 (from 7 verified customers) The MSC World Europa leads the innovative MSC World Class fleet as its pioneer ship. Its futuristic design effortlessly glides through the water, resembling an arrow with a distinctive plumb bow and an unprecedented Y-shaped aft. Unveiling the spectacular 104-meter-long Europa Promenade, guests are treated to awe-inspiring ocean vistas. This remarkable space is partly open to the sky and partly shielded by a striking LED-sky screen, which showcases customized displays throughout the day. Distinguished as the first LNG-powered vessel in the MSC Cruises fleet, the MSC World Europa exemplifies the company's commitment to environmental stewardship. Equipped with a state-of-the-art wastewater treatment system and cutting-edge green technologies, this ship represents a significant stride towards achieving "zero emissions operations." By integrating breakthrough sustainability measures, MSC World Europa brings the fleet one step closer to its ultimate goal.MSC World Europa is a groundbreaking addition to the MSC Cruises fleet that is set to redefine the concept of luxury and innovation on the high seas. Read more This stunning cruise ship combines state-of-the-art technology with elegant design, offering an unparalleled experience for those seeking the ultimate vacation. Culinary delights await you on board the MSC World Europa, with an impressive selection of restaurants and bars offering a diverse range of international cuisines. Indulge your taste buds with gourmet dishes crafted by world-class chefs or savor a casual meal at one of the ship's more relaxed dining venues. From authentic Mediterranean flavors to exotic Asian delicacies, there's something to satisfy every palate. Unwind and rejuvenate at the MSC Aurea Spa, a sanctuary of tranquility offering a wide range of treatments and therapies designed to pamper your mind, body, and soul. Relax by the pool, or soak up the sun on the spacious sun deck with panoramic views of the ocean. For those seeking entertainment and excitement, the MSC World Europa does not disappoint. Experience world-class performances at the state-of-the-art theater, catch a movie under the stars at the outdoor cinema, or try your luck at the glamorous casino. The ship also features a cutting-edge sports complex, where you can stay active with a variety of sports and fitness activities. Innovative technology is at the heart of the MSC World Europa, with futuristic features like artificial intelligence assistants and immersive virtual reality experiences enhancing your journey. Stay connected with high-speed internet access throughout the ship and enjoy the convenience of smart cabins equipped with the latest amenities. CLEAN CRUISING EXPERT REVIEW Sarah wowed by MSC World Europa Onboard Experience Dining Bars Entertainment Activities Health & Fitness Kids Inclusions Dining MSC Europa will feature 13 dining venues, including an incredible six speciality restaurants such as the classic American-style steakhouse Butcher’s Cut and Asian-inspired Kaito Teppanyaki Grill and Sushi Bar, as well as the newly launched Latin American street food-inspired Hola! Tacos & Cantina. Read more The new prototype offers an unexpected, interactive experience with two entirely new locations: the trendy Chef’s Garden Kitchen focussing on flavourful microgreens and La Pescaderia, a traditional seafood grill with alfresco seating. Guests also have the opportunity to discover three ample restaurant-buffets on board, each offering their distinct ambiance, including a brand-new location open 24/7. Read less Bars The MSC Europa will have a wide variety of bars and cafes to match any mood such as the Masters of the Sea Pub, which be split across two decks and brew craft beer specially on board for the first time. Read more Other concepts include the Elixir - Mixology Bar with elaborate signature cocktails, a South Asian-style tea room filled with perfumes from the East, an authentic Emporium coffee bar with selections from around the world, a widely stocked The Gin Project inspired by a real distillery, a zesty juice bar made from fresh ingredients, a gelateria with a multitude of flavours to tempt your sweet-tooth, and many more to come! Read less Entertainment Stroll through the indoor promenade, featuring the iconic LED Dome at Deck 6, and the impressive 90-metre-long outdoor promenade at Deck 8 to discover a futuristic city of choice, variety and excitement. Any time of the day or night, there’s always something to see, do, try or test on MSC World Europa. Activities The onboard entertainment offers huge variety and choice for everyone - from the fleet’s largest water park with VR technology to the Luna Park Studio, a multifunctional venue with 300 seats and built to tailor to any performance or event. And as always, the award-winning MSC family offering features state-of-the-art facilities for kids with a dedicated area of the ship as well as a range of kids’ clubs and tailor-made programmes designed for each age group. Read more Onboard you can also discover the longest at sea dry slide and descend swiftly through the ship from deck 20 to deck 8. A true piece of art made of stainless steel and spanning 11 decks, the sleek curves of the slide will not only be popular for those who like a bit of adventure but is bound to become one of the most photographed areas on the ship. Read less Health & Fitness Restore body and soul in the MSC Aurea Spa, a luxurious Balinese spa on board on MSC World Europa. Comprising a thermal area, Gym, Beauty salon and Barber shop, it offers a wealth of wellness and beauty treatments to relax, pamper and revitalise you. Kids Onboard you will find endless activities for all ages with an innovative Aquapark, Kids’ Club, MSC Sports Plex, Bumper cars & rollerblades arena and Video arcades – this is just a tiny sneak peek of what is waiting for you on board MSC World Europa.
